name: Trossen Robotics Mobile AI
summary: A wheeled cart with two WidowX AI follower arms and two leader arms for recording teleoperated demonstrations and training imitation-learning models.

germany.statusNote: Generation Robots lists it with an order button from €38,500 net (delivery 4-6 weeks); MYBOTSHOP in Germany, Trossen's listed distributor, lists it with price on request.

priceEur.note: Base version without computer; €46,200 including 20% VAT as shown.

priceOther.market: Trossen Robotics US price without laptop

sellers.name: Generation Robots
sellers.note: Option with Trossen TOTL workstation also listed.

sellers.name: MYBOTSHOP.DE
sellers.note: Trossen's listed distributor for Germany. Shop lists Mobile AI with 'Preis auf Anfrage'; deliverable 10 days after order.

specs.label: Arms
specs.value: 2 WidowX AI follower arms plus 2 leader arms

specs.label: Compute
specs.value: None in base version; optional laptop or TOTL workstation

specs.label: Software
specs.value: LeRobot, ROS 2, MuJoCo, Gazebo, NVIDIA Isaac, OpenPI

notes: The arms sit on a wheeled frame that is moved between sites; Trossen points to its SLATE base for autonomous navigation, while Generation Robots calls the platform motorised. Whether this kit drives itself is not clear.
Arm payload not stated on the pages read.
Trossen calls its systems research and supervised-deployment systems, not safety-rated cobots.
